input: I'm bringing up a quad-camera system using two MIPI CSI-2 D-PHY receivers (4-lane each) that share a single ISP input port via a virtual channel multiplexer. Under simultaneous streaming from all four sensors, I observe periodic lane de-sync errors logged by the DPHY_ERR_SOT_SYNC_HS register on the second receiver. The sensors use different pixel rates (60 Mpix/s and 90 Mpix/s) and I've set separate VC IDs (0–3). What lane merger arbitration constraints and DPHY settling time parameters should I check in the CSI-2 PHY configuration to eliminate the SOT sync faults?
